Tidings of Comfort and Joy 2026

November 28, 2026 @ 4:00 pm – 7:00 pm
Free
  • « Trick or Treat 2026 in Downtown Henderson, NC
  • Henderson, NC Christmas Parade 2026 »

The Vance County Arts Council invites the community to celebrate the holiday season at its annual Tidings of Comfort and Joy Pre-Christmas Concert, Saturday, November 28, 2026, at 4:00 PM at McGregor Hall Performing Arts Center in Henderson.

This year marks the 10th year that the Vance County Arts Council has presented the holiday program free to the community, continuing its commitment to making arts and cultural programming accessible to everyone.

Tidings of Comfort and Joy has become a special way for families, friends and neighbors to come together before Christmas and enjoy an afternoon of holiday celebration at McGregor Hall.

The program will also feature the crowning of the 2026 Holiday Pageant winners, adding another special community tradition to the afternoon’s festivities.

The Vance County Arts Council works throughout the year to bring quality multicultural arts programming to Vance County, with a special focus on school-aged children, at-risk youth, adults with disabilities and the community as a whole.

Make Tidings of Comfort and Joy part of your holiday season.
